unsupported.name: Trend Micro Incorporated
unsupported.reason: Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (4704). It was once an SEC foreign private issuer under this CIK, but its own Form 15F-12G terminated that registration, and its EDGAR record has no 10-Q, 10-K, 6-K, or 20-F since 2009 (confirmed against its submissions record on 2026-09-30: the only filings are legacy 6-K/20-F/S-8/SC 13G items from 2000-2009, ending with the deregistration). It now reports quarterly and annual results under Japanese disclosure rules (kessan tanshin / yukashoken hokokusho) via the Tokyo Stock Exchange and its own newsroom, not SEC XBRL, so no discrete quarterly revenue exists in EDGAR structured data for it.

unsupported.name: Cisco (security)
unsupported.reason: Cisco's total revenue is not a security figure, and EDGAR's companyfacts API only exposes entity-wide, non-dimensional facts — the security product-category split Cisco discloses (e.g. in its 10-K's segment footnote) is tagged with a member/axis dimension that companyfacts strips out. Pulling it needs the filing's own XBRL viewer or the frames API per member, not a plain revenue concept lookup, so it stays out of this structured runner. Fiscal year end 0725; most recent 10-K 2026-09-02.

unsupported.name: Akamai (security segment)
unsupported.reason: Same limitation as Cisco: Akamai's security-line revenue is a disclosed segment, not a top-level GAAP concept, and companyfacts does not expose dimensional (segment-member) facts. Total Akamai revenue is tracked but is not a security figure, so it is left out entirely rather than published mislabeled.
